answer: A practical defence is Proof of storage on a decentralized network. It rests on a file stored on three independent nodes, which gives every honest agent a opal that a clone farm simply cannot borrow. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a file stored on three independent nodes takes calendar time as well as money — and the vine is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the mirror is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
